notes: The conference calendar (Modern Events Calendar plugin) holds only 34 entries in total, 5 of them before Oct 2025 (marriage retreat Apr 2025, singles event May 2025, Hispanic women's retreat Aug 2025, men's retreat Oct 10-13 2025 is in window). Calendar is thin: few entries Oct 2025-Jan 2026, and none after Nov 15, 2026.
Youth is the strongest visible pattern: ten Area Youth Federation weekends across five regions plus Youth & Young Adult camp meeting, summer camp (first in seven years) and Global Youth Day.

No public evangelistic series appears on the conference calendar; the State of the Conference report (Sep 2026) mentions extra outside funding for evangelism, 93 baptisms and 196 professions of faith in 2026 so far. Evangelism activity is visible only through local-church news (e.g., Bethesda Temple "Elevate").

Out of window and excluded: Keeping the Flames Blazing marriage retreat (Apr 2025), Singles Mingle (May 2025), Hispanic Women's Retreat (Aug 2025), Breath of Life Hope Rally St. Louis (Jun 22-Jul 5 2025, 44 baptisms), conference session (Aug 3 2025), ordination of two pastors (Aug 2 2025).
A FRAME website training webinar for churches (communication) was reported in May 2026 without a date; not listed as an event.
Calendar URLs on several events point to off-site pages (camprivercrest.org, hilton.com, asimidamerica.org); the central-states.org event page or feed is used as the source URL instead.
